title: Contents Amount Sharing the Deductible Layer on a Building Payment — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
On the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own), when the other flood policy's deductible layer covers both the building and the contents at the address, a building payment shares that layer with the contents amount sworn for the date of loss.

**Rule.** The contents amount sworn for the date of loss that shares the deductible layer is settled as follows, every case requiring that BizFlood policy to declare a contents value for the address: when the latest contents proof of loss for the date of loss was received after the proof-of-loss period, it is the amounts sworn on the other contents proofs of loss for the date of loss added together; when contents proofs of loss were filed for the date of loss and the latest was received within that period, it is the amounts sworn on all of them added together; when no contents proof of loss was filed for the date of loss but contents payments were issued for it on the adjuster's report signed in lieu of a proof of loss, it is those contents payments less the contents payment items voided; otherwise it is nothing.

The BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days after the date of loss.

## Ladder

| BizFlood policy declares a contents value for the address | Contents proofs of loss and payments for the date of loss | Contents amount sharing the layer |
|---|---|---|
| yes | latest contents proof of loss received after day 60 | total of the other contents proofs of loss |
| yes | contents proofs of loss, latest received by day 60 | total of all of them |
| yes | none filed; contents payments issued on the adjuster's report signed in lieu | those payments less voided items |
| yes | none of the above | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical; date of loss 1 August)

- Contents proofs of loss of 20,000.00 and 5,000.00, latest received 15 September: 25,000.00.
- No contents proof of loss; contents payments of 8,000.00 with a 1,000.00 item voided: 7,000.00.
- The statement of values declares no contents value for the address: nothing, whatever contents proofs of loss exist.
